oracle.activityBoundary: every callActivity argument and return value crosses oracle/lib/boundary.js, as the Durable Task extension serialises them; OutboundInformantRegister therefore receives the ORCHESTRATOR's hearing, not the copy SetInformantRegister mutated

contract.basis: each clone is a complete prosecutionCase with fresh, distinct uuids for the case, its defendants, their masterDefendantIds and their offences, so no identity is duplicated and cpp-platform-core-domain/criminal-court-public-model/src/main/resources/json/schema/global/hearing.json prosecutionCases.minItems is satisfied a fortiori

provenance.note: Two prosecution authorities (TFL, TVL), no courtCentre fields, hearingDays empty.
provenance.operatorDescription: Clones the first prosecution case under fresh authority identifiers, so one hearing yields N documents.
provenance.operatorRationale: One document per prosecuting authority is the whole point of the service. SetInformantRegister/index.js:39-53 de-duplicates by prosecutionAuthorityId only; the per-authority defendant filter is a separate pass (index.js:121-139). A port that keys on the wrong field produces the right count and the wrong contents, which only shows up at N >= 3.
